name: geo-puck-workspace
description: Geo Puck: any place on Earth as a terrain diorama on a compass plinth, as libraries.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/data && npm run build -w packages/puck
scripts.check: npm run check -w packages/data && npm run check -w packages/puck && npm run check -w apps/demo
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/data && npm test -w packages/puck
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack -w packages/data -w packages/puck --pack-destination dist-packs
